was unsure whether to leave a ‘poor’ 2 star review as the care that I have received has been good, but I feel the need to draw attention to the issue of access.
Saddleworth Practice is so very difficult to access as a patient, very difficult to speak to or get an appointment with a doctor or other medical professional (phone line busy, long queue or rings out) and difficult to get an appointment once through to reception as appointment slots are usually full.
I am sure that access is an issue everywhere to a degree but it is particularly acute at Saddleworth Practice. As a comparator, I called Leesbrook surgery today and got straight through to reception.
This seems to be the experience for most patients at Saddleworth Practice.
This is what patients say:
Only 30% of respondents find it easy to get through to this GP practice by phone vs
Local (CCG) average: 60% National average: 68%.
I expect that the nub of the issue is that the surgery does not have capacity (staff, consultation rooms, clerical staff) to care for the 30,000 population size and demographic of Saddleworth.
Unfortunately, as things stand, this is a risk to patients’ health outcomes, particularly early diagnosis and treatment.
